source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_ATM_ISSCARD WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT
convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CRD_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_ID
,STG.[CRD_UUID]
,[CRD_BCR_ID]
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_PRS_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_PRS_ID
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_INS_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_INS_ID
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_BRN_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_BRN_ID
,[CRD_NUMBER]
,[CRD_ISSUE_DATE]
,[CRD_EXPIRY_DATE]
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_PREVIOUS_CRD_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_PREVIOUS_CRD_ID
,[CRD_CARDHOLDER_NAME]
,convert(date,[CRD_CREATION_DATE]) as CRD_CREATION_DATE
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CRD_STS_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_STS_ID
,convert(date,[CRD_STATUS_DATE]) as CRD_STATUS_DATE
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_CREATED_BY],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_CREATED_BY
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(CRD_CREATED_TS, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as CRD_CREATED_TS
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_UPDATED_BY],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_UPDATED_BY
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(CRD_UPDATED_TS, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as CRD_UPDATED_TS
,[CRD_AUDIT_LOG]
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_PARENT_CRD_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_PARENT_CRD_ID
,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_ALLOW_RENEWAL],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_ALLOW_RENEWAL
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_IS_PRIMARY],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_IS_PRIMARY
,[CRD_KIT_NUMBER]
,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_IS_LINKED],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_IS_LINKED
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_CTS_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_CTS_ID
,convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_EMB_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_EMB_ID
,convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_BRN_ID_ORIGINAL],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_BRN_ID_ORIGINAL
,[CRD_NUMBER_ENC]
,[CRD_NUMBER_MASKED]
,convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_CCL_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_CCL_ID
,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_IS_CARD_POSTED],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_IS_CARD_POSTED
,[CRD_SEQUENCE_NUMBER]
,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_LIFE_CYCLE],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_LIFE_CYCLE
,[CRD_PIN_OFFSET]
,[CRD_PIN_OFFSET_TS]
,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_IS_CORPORATE],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_IS_CORPORATE
,[CRD_CORPORATE_CIF]
,[CRD_CORPORATE_NAME]
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_KEY_ROTATION_NUMBER],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_KEY_ROTATION_NUMBER
,[CRD_EMBOSSING_NAME]
,convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_PIN_GENERATED],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_PIN_GENERATED
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [BUSC].[ATM_ISSCARD_DELTA] DELTA
 LEFT JOIN [d360].[STG_ATM_ISSCARD] STG ON convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CRD_ID],' ',''),''),0))  = DELTA.CRD_ID
 --AND STG.[CRD_UUID] = DELTA.[CRD_UUID]
  WHERE H = 'D'
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_ATM_CLIENTCARDMAPPING WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT 
convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CCM_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CCM_ID
,[CCM_UUID]
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CCM_CLT_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CCM_CLT_ID
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CCM_BAC_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CCM_BAC_ID
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CCM_CRD_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CCM_CRD_ID
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CCM_STS_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CCM_STS_ID
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CCM_CREATED_BY],' ',''),''),0)) as CCM_CREATED_BY
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(CCM_CREATED_TS, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as CCM_CREATED_TS
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CCM_UPDATED_BY],' ',''),''),0)) as CCM_UPDATED_BY
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(CCM_UPDATED_TS, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as CCM_UPDATED_TS
,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CCM_TYPE_DEFAULT],' ',''),''),0)) as CCM_TYPE_DEFAULT
,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CCM_OVERALL_DEFAULT],' ',''),''),0)) as CCM_OVERALL_DEFAULT
,[CCM_AUDIT_LOG]
,convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CCM_INS_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CCM_INS_ID
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [BUSC].[ATM_CLIENTCARDMAPPING_DELTA] DELTA
 LEFT JOIN [d360].[STG_ATM_CLIENTCARDMAPPING] STG ON convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CCM_ID],' ',''),''),0)) = DELTA.CCM_ID
 AND convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CCM_CLT_ID],' ',''),''),0)) = DELTA.CCM_CLT_ID
  WHERE H = 'D'
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_ATM_CASHCARDACCOUNT WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT
convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CAC_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CAC_ID
,STG.[CAC_UUID]
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CAC_CLT_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CAC_CLT_ID
,[CAC_ACCOUNT_NUMBER]
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CAC_BAT_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CAC_BAT_ID
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CAC_STS_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CAC_STS_ID
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CAC_CREATED_BY],' ',''),''),0)) as CAC_CREATED_BY
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(CAC_CREATED_TS, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as CAC_CREATED_TS
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CAC_UPDATED_BY],' ',''),''),0)) as CAC_UPDATED_BY
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(CAC_UPDATED_TS, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as CAC_UPDATED_TS
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CAC_BRN_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CAC_BRN_ID
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CAC_PRS_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CAC_PRS_ID
,[CAC_AUDIT_LOG]
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CAC_INS_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CAC_INS_ID
,[CAC_ACCOUNT_NUMBER_MASKED]
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CAC_KEY_ROTATION_NUMBER],' ',''),''),0)) as CAC_KEY_ROTATION_NUMBER
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [BUSC].[ATM_CASHCARDACCOUNT_DELTA] DELTA
 LEFT JOIN [d360].[STG_ATM_CASHCARDACCOUNT] STG ON convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CAC_ID],' ',''),''),0)) = DELTA.CAC_ID
 --AND STG.[CAC_UUID] = DELTA.CAC_UUID
  WHERE H = 'D'
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_ATM_CASHBANKACCOUNT WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT 
convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[BAC_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as BAC_ID
,STG.[BAC_UUID]
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([BAC_CLT_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as BAC_CLT_ID
,[BAC_ACCOUNT_NUMBER]
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([BAC_BAT_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as BAC_BAT_ID
,[BAC_BAT_ID]
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([BAC_CREATED_BY],' ',''),''),0)) as BAC_CREATED_BY
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(BAC_CREATED_TS, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as BAC_CREATED_TS
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([BAC_UPDATED_BY],' ',''),''),0)) as BAC_UPDATED_BY
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(BAC_UPDATED_TS, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as BAC_UPDATED_TS
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[BAC_STS_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as BAC_STS_ID
,[BAC_AUDIT_LOG]
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([BAC_CUR_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as BAC_CUR_ID
,convert(numeric(5,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([BAC_INS_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as BAC_INS_ID
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([BAC_BRN_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as BAC_BRN_ID
,[BAC_ACCOUNT_NUMBER_MASKED]

,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm

 LEFT JOIN [d360].[STG_ATM_CASHBANKACCOUNT] STG 
 ON convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[BAC_ID],' ',''),''),0)) = DELTA.BAC_ID
--AND convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[BAC_STS_ID],' ',''),''),0)) = DELTA.BAC_STS_ID

SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_ATM_CARD WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT 
convert(numeric(19,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CRD_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_ID
,STG.[CRD_PAN]
,convert(numeric(5,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_CARD_SEQUENCE_NBR],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_CARD_SEQUENCE_NBR
,convert(numeric(19,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_CPD_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_CPD_ID
,convert(date,[CRD_PURGE_DATE]) as CRD_PURGE_DATE
,convert(date,[CRD_ISSUE_DATE_1]) as CRD_ISSUE_DATE_1
,convert(date,[CRD_EXPIRY_DATE_1]) as CRD_EXPIRY_DATE_1
,[CRD_DISCRETIONARY_DATA_1]
,convert(date,[CRD_ISSUE_DATE_2]) as CRD_ISSUE_DATE_2
,convert(date,[CRD_EXPIRY_DATE_2]) as CRD_EXPIRY_DATE_2
,[CRD_DISCRETIONARY_DATA_2]
,[CRD_CARDHOLDER_NAME]
,[CRD_REGISTRATION_ADDR1]
,[CRD_REGISTRATION_ADDR2]
,[CRD_REGISTRATION_ADDR3]
,[CRD_REGISTRATION_ADDR4]
,[CRD_REGISTRATION_ADDR5]
,[CRD_REGISTRATION_ZIP_CODE]
,[CRD_COMMENT]
,convert(date,[CRD_CREATION_DATE]) as CRD_CREATION_DATE
,STG.[CRD_STATUS_1]
,convert(date,[CRD_STATUS_1_DATE]) as CRD_STATUS_1_DATE
,[CRD_STATUS_2]
,convert(date,[CRD_STATUS_2_DATE]) as CRD_STATUS_2_DATE
,convert(numeric(5,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_PVKI],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_PVKI
,convert(date,[CRD_PREV_PIN_CHANGE_DATE]) as CRD_PREV_PIN_CHANGE_DATE
,[CRD_CURRENT_PVV]
,[CRD_PREVIOUS_PVV]
,convert(numeric(5,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_PIN_RETRY_COUNT],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_PIN_RETRY_COUNT
,convert(numeric(19,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_PRIMARY_ACN_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_PRIMARY_ACN_ID
,convert(numeric(19,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_SECONDARY_ACN_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_SECONDARY_ACN_ID
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_LAST_FEP_HOST_TRACE_NBR],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_LAST_FEP_HOST_TRACE_NBR
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_LAST_HOST_FEP_TRACE_NBR],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_LAST_HOST_FEP_TRACE_NBR
,convert(numeric(19,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_PART_NO],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_PART_NO
,[CRD_CUSTOM_DATA]
,[CRD_OPEN_ACCOUNT_IND]
,[CRD_CURRENT_PIN_OFFSET]
,[CRD_PREVIOUS_PIN_OFFSET]
,[CRD_LAST_SOURCE]
,[CRD_LAST_TERMINAL_ID]
,[CRD_PIN_BLOCK]
,[CRD_PREV_PIN_BLOCK]
,[CRD_CUSTOM_INDEX_1]
,[CRD_SEND_PIN_UNBLOCK_SCRIPT]
,[CRD_SEND_PIN_CHANGE_SCRIPT]
,[CRD_FUNCTIONS]
,[CRD_OVERRIDE_PERMISSION]
,convert(numeric(19,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_ISS_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_ISS_ID
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_BIN],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_BIN
,[CRD_EMV_LEVEL]
,[CRD_LIMIT_CONFIG]
,[CRD_MULTIPLE_ACCOUNTS]
,convert(numeric(19,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_CUST_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_CUST_ID
,convert(numeric(19,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_PIN_MAILER_CADD_ID_FK],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_PIN_MAILER_CADD_ID_FK
,convert(numeric(19,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_STMT_MAILER_CADD_ID_FK],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_STMT_MAILER_CADD_ID_FK
,convert(numeric(19,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_CARD_DELIVERY_CADD_ID_FK],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_CARD_DELIVERY_CADD_ID_FK
,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(CRD_LAST_UPDATE_TS, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as CRD_LAST_UPDATE_TS
,convert(numeric(19,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_PREVIOUS_PVV_EKY_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_PREVIOUS_PVV_EKY_ID
,convert(numeric(19,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_CURRENT_PVV_EKY_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_CURRENT_PVV_EKY_ID
,convert(numeric(19,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_DISCRETIONARY_D1_EKY_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_DISCRETIONARY_D1_EKY_ID
,convert(numeric(19,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_DISCRETIONARY_D2_EKY_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_DISCRETIONARY_D2_EKY_ID
,convert(numeric(19,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CRD_PAN_EKY_ID],' ',''),''),0)) as CRD_PAN_EKY_ID
,[CRD_PREVIOUS_PVN2]
,[CRD_CURRENT_PVN2]
,[CRD_CELL_PHONE]
,[CRD_EMAIL]
,[FileName]
,[TABLE_NAME]
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [BUSC].[ATM_CARD_DELTA] DELTA
 LEFT JOIN [d360].[STG_ATM_CARD] STG ON convert(numeric(19,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CRD_ID],' ',''),''),0)) = DELTA.CRD_ID
 --AND STG.[CRD_PAN] = DELTA.CRD_PAN
  WHERE H = 'D'
